node.statement: At p the map G fixes p and, because its coordinate representative is y->Ay near 0, its differential is DG_p=A. Hence det(I-DG_p)=det(I-A) is nonzero. The registered definition def-lefschetz-fixed-point-data now applies within its actual scope (the compact orientable manifold M) and gives ind(G,p)=sgn det(I-A).
